auth.signIn.facebook.title.reason: Only the title of the native window that the desktop apps open, and of the sheet that the iOS app shows, for signing in with Facebook, which the system draws outside the page, so no page screenshot shows it.
auth.signIn.facebook.title.explanation: Title of the window that the desktop apps open, and of the sheet that the iOS app shows, for signing in with Facebook; the system draws the title bar, so no screenshot shows it.

chat.composer.errors.sendFailed.reason: Only shown when sending throws right away, and sending only queues the message: a failed send shows “Not sent” on the message instead.
chat.composer.errors.sendFailed.explanation: Error toast for a chat message that couldn’t be sent; today a message that fails to send shows “Not sent” on it instead, so this toast never appears.

chat.notification.*.reason: Only in the system notifications that the desktop and Android builds show for chat messages, which the system draws outside the page, so no page screenshot shows them.
chat.notification.*.explanation: Body of the system notification that the desktop and Android apps show for a new chat message, under the sender’s name; the system draws it outside the app, so no screenshot shows it; the sender’s gender is unknown, so prefer wording without grammatical gender.

chat.notification.you.reason: Only the user's name in the MessagingStyle of the Android chat notifications, which Android requires and uses only for messages from the user, and the system draws those notifications outside the page, so no page screenshot shows it.
chat.notification.you.explanation: Name for you in the chat message notifications of the Android app, which Android uses to label a message from you; the system draws them in the notification shade, outside the app, so no screenshot shows it.

commands.filterGrid.errors.applyFailed.reason: Only when applying the filters or closing the command center throws, or navigating to Grid rejects. Applying them sets them in memory, starts Grid over and saves them in the background, and a failed save shows browse.grid.searchFilters.errors.updateFailed instead. Closing only changes state, and SvelteKit's goto resolves even when another navigation aborts it and rejects only when a navigation callback throws, which none of the app's callbacks do.
commands.filterGrid.errors.applyFailed.explanation: Error toast for when the “Filter Grid…” command in the Command Center couldn’t apply the filters; only saving them can fail, and that shows a different message, so this toast never appears.

common.location.permissionReason.reason: Only in the location permission prompt that iOS draws over the app, so no page screenshot shows it.
common.location.permissionReason.explanation: Reason that iOS shows in its prompt when Open Grind first asks for your location; iOS draws the prompt over the app, so no screenshot shows it.

common.media.errors.pickedItemsLoadFaile.reason: Only the iOS photo picker reports picked items that never loaded, and demo builds pick from a file input instead, so no page screenshot shows it.
common.media.errors.pickedItemsLoadFaile.explanation: Error toast that the iOS app shows after you pick photos or videos when some of them couldn’t be loaded from the photo library; screenshots come from a build without the iOS photo picker, so none shows it.

common.media.slots.a11y.cancelled.reason: Only announced in the visually hidden status region of MediaSlotGrid when Escape cancels a keyboard move, so no screenshot shows it.
common.media.slots.a11y.cancelled.explanation: Screen reader announcement when Escape cancels moving a photo or video tile with the keyboard and puts it back where it was; it is only read aloud, so no screenshot shows it.

common.media.slots.a11y.dropped.reason: Only announced in the visually hidden status region of MediaSlotGrid when Space puts a held tile down, so no screenshot shows it.
common.media.slots.a11y.dropped.explanation: Screen reader announcement when Space puts a photo or video tile down after moving it with the keyboard; {{position}} is the place it now has and {{total}} is the number of tiles, and it is only read aloud.

common.media.slots.a11y.lifted.reason: Only announced in the visually hidden status region of MediaSlotGrid when Space picks a tile up, so no screenshot shows it.
common.media.slots.a11y.lifted.explanation: Screen reader announcement when Space picks up a photo or video tile to move it with the keyboard; {{position}} is the place it has and {{total}} is the number of tiles, and it is only read aloud.

common.media.slots.a11y.moved.reason: Only announced in the visually hidden status region of MediaSlotGrid while the arrow keys move a held tile, so no screenshot shows it.
common.media.slots.a11y.moved.explanation: Screen reader announcement each time an arrow key moves a picked-up photo or video tile one place; {{position}} is its new place and {{total}} is the number of tiles, and it is only read aloud.

common.media.slots.a11y.removed.reason: Only the accessible name of a tile marked for removal, and no view marks one, so no screenshot shows it.
common.media.slots.a11y.removed.explanation: Screen reader name of a photo or video tile marked for removal in Edit Profile or the album editor; {{label}} is the tile’s usual name, and it is only read aloud, so no screenshot shows it.

common.media.slots.a11y.reorderHint.reason: Only in the hidden element that aria-describedby points each reorderable tile to, so no screenshot shows it.
common.media.slots.a11y.reorderHint.explanation: Screen reader hint read with each photo or video tile in Edit Profile and the album editor, telling how to move the tile with the keyboard; it is only read aloud, so no screenshot shows it.

feedback.appError.contentTooLarge.reason: Only sign-in and Try Again failure toasts show this message, and neither command fails with this error. Only file uploads do, and upload screens show feedback.appError.overLimit for it instead.
feedback.appError.contentTooLarge.explanation: Error message for a file larger than the upload limit, shown in an error toast; files that are too large name the limit in their own message instead, so this text never appears today.

feedback.appError.notSignedIn.reason: Only sign-in and Try Again failure toasts show this message. Sign-in commands never fail with this error, and Try Again shows its own expired message for it instead.
feedback.appError.notSignedIn.explanation: Error message for an action that needs you to be signed in, shown in an error toast; signing in never fails this way and an expired session shows its own message, so this text never appears today.

interest.taps.notification.reason: Only in the system notification that the desktop and Android builds show for a received tap, which the system draws outside the page, so no page screenshot shows it.
interest.taps.notification.explanation: Body of the system notification that the desktop and Android apps show for a received tap, under the sender’s name; the system draws it outside the app, so no screenshot shows it; the sender’s gender is unknown, so prefer wording without grammatical gender.

media.picker.filters.*.reason: The native file dialog shows these file type names, and the web build has no native dialog.
media.picker.filters.*.explanation: Name of a file type choice in the system file dialog that the desktop app opens to pick photos and videos; the system draws that dialog, so no screenshot shows it.

media.uploads.notification.reason: Only in the Android notification that shows while media uploads, which the system draws outside the page, so no page screenshot shows it.
media.uploads.notification.explanation: Title of the notification that the Android app shows in the notification shade while photos or videos upload; the system draws it outside the app, so no screenshot shows it.

profile.miniCard.a11y.anonymous.reason: Only an anonymous profile card with a link carries this label, and the app's only anonymous card, a hidden viewer's preview in Viewed Me, has no link.
profile.miniCard.a11y.anonymous.explanation: Screen reader label of a profile card link that doesn’t show who the user is; the only such card, the locked preview of a viewer in Viewed Me, has no link, so the label is never read out.

shell.menuBar.*.reason: Only in the macOS menu bar, which the system draws outside the page, so no page screenshot shows it.
shell.menuBar.*.explanation: Name of a menu or a menu command in the macOS menu bar at the top of the screen, beside items that macOS names itself in each language; the system draws the menu bar, so no screenshot shows it.

shell.notFound.clippy.*.reason: Reachable by pressing and holding the “?” on the 404 page, which flips it to clippy.avif and opens this tooltip, but left out on purpose: clippy.avif has no license, so no screenshot shows the flipped face, even with a placeholder in its place.
shell.notFound.clippy.*.explanation: Part of the hidden Clippy joke on the “Page not found” page, shown by pressing and holding the “?”, where each list item finishes “Don’t worry, Clippy would never”; screenshots leave it out because the Clippy image has no license.

shell.predecessor.*.reason: Only in the native dialog that the macOS app shows before its window opens, while an Open Grind from before the bundle identifier change still runs, so no page screenshot shows it.
shell.predecessor.*.explanation: Part of the dialog that the macOS app shows as it opens while an older version of Open Grind is still running; macOS draws the dialog before the app’s window opens, so no screenshot shows it.

shell.webViewWarning.*.reason: Only in the native dialog that the Android app shows over the page when the system WebView is older than the app supports, so no page screenshot shows it.
shell.webViewWarning.*.explanation: Part of the warning dialog that the Android app shows as it opens when the phone’s Android System WebView is older than the app supports; Android draws the dialog, so no screenshot shows it.

shell.webViewWarning.desktop.*.reason: Only in the native dialog that the Windows and Linux apps show as they open when WebView2 or WebKitGTK is older than the app supports, so no page screenshot shows it.
shell.webViewWarning.desktop.*.explanation: Part of the warning dialog that the Windows and Linux apps show as they open when the system’s WebView2 or WebKitGTK is older than the app supports; the system draws the dialog, so no screenshot shows it.

updates.location.*.reason: Only in the native dialog that a macOS release build shows before its window opens when it runs from outside an Applications folder, so no page screenshot shows it.
updates.location.*.explanation: Part of the dialog that the macOS app shows as it opens from outside the Applications folder, where it can’t update itself; macOS draws the dialog before the app’s window opens, so no screenshot shows it.

updates.transfers.channel.reason: Only the name of the Android notification channel for downloads and uploads, which the system notification settings show, so no page screenshot shows it.
updates.transfers.channel.explanation: Name of the notification category for downloads and uploads that Android lists in the app’s notification settings; the system draws those settings, so no screenshot shows it.
